author: packs
description: Contract views and KPIs (W1-T15): my contracts, active contracts by notice deadline, obligations due and contracts with playbook deviations to review, and the reports cycle time by stage (drafting, negotiation, signature, from the contract's versions) and playbook deviation count, beside the three earlier ones.
name: contract-management-views

definition.name: Contract: My Contracts
definition.sql: SELECT id, title, status, counterparty, end_date, notice_deadline FROM contract WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE

definition.name: Contract: Expiring by Notice Deadline
definition.sql: SELECT id, title, counterparty, notice_deadline, end_date FROM contract WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND status = 'active' AND notice_deadline IS NOT NULL

definition.name: Obligation: Due
definition.sql: SELECT id, title, due_date, contract_ref FROM obligation WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND is_complete IS NOT TRUE AND due_date IS NOT NULL

definition.name: Contract: Deviations to Review
definition.sql: SELECT id, title, status, playbook_deviations FROM contract WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND playbook_deviations IS NOT NULL AND playbook_deviations NOT IN ('', '[]') AND status IN ('draft', 'review')

definition.name: Contract: Cycle Time by Stage
definition.sql: SELECT s.stage, ROUND(AVG(s.days)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days, COUNT(*) AS contracts FROM (SELECT c.created_at, v.first_draft, v.last_counter, v.signed FROM contract c JOIN (SELECT contract_id, MIN(created_at) FILTER (WHERE source = 'draft') AS first_draft, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE source = 'counterparty_upload') AS last_counter, MIN(created_at) FILTER (WHERE source = 'signed') AS signed FROM contract_version WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE GROUP BY contract_id) v ON v.contract_id = c.id::text WHERE c.is_active IS NOT FALSE) x CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('1 drafting', EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.first_draft - x.created_at)) / 86400), ('2 negotiation', EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.last_counter - x.first_draft)) / 86400), ('3 signature', EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.signed - COALESCE(x.last_counter, x.first_draft))) / 86400)) AS s(stage, days) WHERE s.days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.stage ORDER BY s.stage

definition.name: Contract: Playbook Deviation Count
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE playbook_deviations IS NOT NULL AND playbook_deviations NOT IN ('', '[]')) AS with_deviations, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE playbook_deviations LIKE '%needs_legal%') AS needing_legal, COUNT(*) AS open_contracts FROM contract WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND status IN ('draft', 'review', 'approved')

title: Pack: contract views and KPIs
